_o: Known failures of Jaskinia's browser suites, each with its reason, and suites that cannot run on the machine that runs them. tools/testy.py lets the listed failures through and nothing else, and says out loud when one passes again, so this list cannot quietly harden into scenery. A skipped suite is named in every summary with its reason; asking for it by name runs it anyway. Remove an entry when its check passes, when the suite can run, or when the page it describes is replaced. Status: tymczasowe (10 Nov 2026).

bledy.test: four wheels set in motion, each its own part
bledy.dlaczego: Unstable on untouched main 7fcedfa (Jaskinia 6.4.1): on 10 Nov 2026 it failed in 6 of 8 runs here, every other check of the part passing. Counting the parts every 100 ms right after the fourth one is set in motion gave 2,2,4,4… and 2,4,4…: for 100 to 300 ms the window holds an older record, then the right one. Likely cause, not yet proven: in src/jaskinia/57b-ruch.js the answer of an older save can arrive after the newer save's timer has fired, and adopt() takes it; the part he has just made then disappears for a moment and its selection is dropped. A probable fix: adopt only the answer of the newest save.
bledy.zdejmij_gdy: the race is fixed in the page and the check passes in 10 runs in a row

pominiete.dlaczego: Needs a folder of real models: files from the owner's public repositories (MAT_REPO in src/jaskinia/57-materialy.js, earlier Box3D meshes) and a glTF sample with its .bin and textures, named as its header says, by default in /home/claude/models. No such folder exists in CI or in this sandbox on 10 Nov 2026. Without it the suite fails its first model checks (5 PASS, 4 FAIL) and then stops on a missing file (ENOENT Box3d___stairs.obj).
pominiete.zdejmij_gdy: the workflow assembles that folder from the public repositories, or the suite learns to skip the checks whose files are missing
